It is now a battlefield between the [[Order of Whispers]] and the forces of [[Mallyx the Unyielding]]. It is said to be an endless plane covered in darkness that traverses [[the Mists]] to places worse than the [[Realm of Torment]]. It is where [[Menzies]] has staged his [[Shadow Army]] while aiding [[Abaddon]] and later Mallyx, waiting alongside [[Torment creature|torment demons]] to utilize the forming [[Chaos Rift]]s leading
